description: Unique identifier for each transaction.
Unique identifier for the collector (drop-off agent / individual/business submitting e-waste).
Unique identifier for the recycler (buyer/processor of the e-waste).
Top-level e-waste material category.
allowed_values: PCB; Cable; Battery; CRT; LCD/display; Motor; Magnet-bearing assembly; Mixed plastics; Other

description: Specific subtype within the material category.
allowed_values: See data dictionary notes / material-specific subcategory lists

description: Weight of the material lot in kilograms.
allowed_values: > 0 in cleaned data (raw may contain 0/negative/missing as data-quality issues)

description: Physical/quality condition of the material.
City where the transaction/pickup occurred.
allowed_values: One of 17 Indian cities used in generation (see README)

description: State corresponding to the city.
Approximate latitude of the transaction location (city-level, jittered).
Approximate longitude of the transaction location (city-level, jittered).
Synthetic price per kg initially quoted/offered (INR, no currency symbol).
Synthetic final negotiated price per kg after inspection (INR). Missing for non-Completed transactions.
Estimated transaction value = weight_kg x quoted_price_per_kg (approx, with generation noise).
Final settled transaction value = weight_kg x final_price_per_kg (approx). Missing for non-Completed transactions.
allowed_values: Numeric, INR, or blank if not Completed

description: Date the transaction was recorded.
Current status of the transaction.
How the material was transferred from collector to recycler.
Mode of payment used for the transaction.
[Ground-truth file only] 1 if the transaction was synthetically injected as an unusual/anomalous record, else 0.
[Ground-truth file only] Category of injected anomaly.
allowed_values: none; price_outlier_low; price_outlier_high; weight_outlier_low; weight_outlier_high; value_mismatch; geo_mismatch; suspicious_combination

description: [Ground-truth file only] Human-readable explanation of why the record is flagged 'Unusual transaction — review'.
example: Price per kg far below normal synthetic distribution for PCB
